english: And so what's being said here is that when our sense perceptions are mistaken, and an object which is actually just a reflection in the mirror appears to us—or we see things like the two moons, or a hair lying there—it is similar to the case with our five sense perceptions when they are not affected by any adventitious defect, but things appear to them to exist by definition.
